items.caption: This modern redraw of 山 in small-seal style shows three upright peaks joined by a curved base, illustrating the mountain-like pictograph in a seal-script form.
items.alt: A black small-seal form of 山: three tall upright strokes rise from a rounded, curved base.
items.selection_reason: It clearly illustrates the seal-script stage listed in the paleographic record and the pictographic interpretation of 山 as mountain peaks.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an ancient inscription. The record lists several script stages but does not date each specimen or establish a continuous stroke-by-stroke development.
